title: Okwebaka kw’Abatuukirivu
intro: Mu kiseera ng’okukkiriza kwali kwa bulabe era ng’ab’amaanyi bafuba okumenya enzikiriza, akabinja akatono ak’emyoyo emito baakola okusalawo okwandizzeemu okuyita mu myaka. Nga badduka byonna bye baali bamanyi, ne banoonya obuddukiro mu kizikiza ekikwese eky’olusozi ne bateeka obwesige bwabwe bwonna mu Allah. Ekyaddirira kyandifuuse akabonero akataggwaawo eri abo abafumiitiriza.
clues: Twali kibinja kya bavubuka abakkiriza Mukama waffe, era yatwongera mu kulungamizibwa.
Twayimirira mu maaso g’abantu baffe ne tulangirira nti tetujja kukoowoola katonda yenna okuggyako Allah.
Twanoonya obuddukiro mu mpuku, nga tugamba nti, ‘Mukama waffe, tusaasire okuva gy’oli era otulung’amya bulungi mu nsonga zaffe.’
Twasula okumala emyaka mingi nnyo, era enjuba yali yeekulukuunya okuva mu mpuku yaffe n’etatukwatako.
Embwa yaffe yali egalamidde nga yeegolodde ku mulyango gw’empuku, ng’etukuuma ng’elinga atunula.
Bwe twazuukusibwa, twebuuza ebbanga lye twamala, era omu ku ffe n’asindikibwa n’ensimbi za ffeeza okugula emmere.
